agents.drug_class_hint: investigational oral small molecule (ACT001, dimethylaminomicheliolide-type parthenolide derivative)

role_evidence.quote: 10 patients will be randomized to the Pembrolizumab only arm (Arm A) and 20 patients will be randomized to the ACT001 plus Pembrolizumab arm (Arm B).
The starting dose of ACT001 will be administered in combination with a single intravenous (IV) infusion of Pembrolizumab.

flag.reason: Pembrolizumab is given in every arm (including the pembrolizumab-only control) so coded soc_backbone per C3, but the title frames 'ACT001 and Anti-PD-1' as the studied combination; could be read as experimental_combination.

coder_notes: Phase 2a randomises within one registered EXPERIMENTAL arm to pembrolizumab only (Arm A, control) vs ACT001 + pembrolizumab (Arm B), hence control_arm_from_other_arms yes. Pembrolizumab is in all arms so treated as backbone; ACT001 is the investigational question. Tumour PK (ACT001 levels in resected tumour) and TME analysis of resected tissue after ~2 weeks of presurgical dosing are planned; target engagement coded yes on the TME-impact objective, though no specific marker is named. 'Glioblastoma Multiforme' without IDH reference = historical.
